scope: Final locally built public Lua/Rust/menu sources with official 2026.10.3103 Linux and Windows engines. All eighteen normal game modules exactly match the selected benchmark modules.
verification: Existing release/smoke-test.sh (14 game entries and menu) plus verification/sdk-menu/run.py --packaged (no arguments, external working directory, keyboard navigation, Lua Gravitas launch/return, clean quit).

windows.runtime: Wine on Linux/NVIDIA, not native Windows

music_method: Existing real stream-position/duration probe, both editions after intro shutdown/game start. Normal playback advances beyond3s; two-second track resets at least twice. Device output is muted during the probe; shipped engine defaults enable sound with master60/music100. Per-platform test workspaces keep native and Wine archive-cache paths separate.
